how.title: How it works
how.p1: Balance is everything settled in minus everything settled out, across all months. Pending and planned entries never touch it until you mark them settled.
how.p2: Debits move along a pipeline: potential → pending → wallet. Marking one as received stamps today's date so it lands in the right month.
how.p3: Fixed monthly rules create a due entry each month. Pausing a rule removes the unpaid instance; paid history always stays.
